package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"
)

// scenario for tests_assert_raw_json_strings_without_response_dto: Brittle raw-JSON string assertions when typed response DTOs exist.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type UserResponse struct {
	ID    int    `json:"id"`
	Name  string `json:"name"`
	Email string `json:"email"`
}

func TestGetUser(t *testing.T) {
	srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(UserResponse{ID: 1, Name: "John", Email: "john@example.com"})
	}))
	defer srv.Close()

	resp, _ := http.Get(srv.URL)
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	resp.Body.Close()

	want := `{"id":1,"name":"John","email":"john@example.com"}`
	if string(body) != want {
		t.Errorf("body = %s, want %s", string(body), want)
	}
}
